title: MEIKO — Feasting Like A Queen!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, which SEKAI should I take a look at today?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Going over to see those two could be fun.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, I'll start with...
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And then, Rin got way too excited and jumped into the chorus a beat too early!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, you're still stuck on that?!
How many times have you told that story already?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Just once! I'm telling Miku for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh? You're not having coffee today, KAITO? That's pretty rare.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have other things from time to time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Things seem as lively as ever.
Now, “I” should be... Aha.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you all for being so patient. Your lunches are ready.

rows.Speaker: Luka & KAITO
rows.Line: Finally!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I ordered the rice omelet lunch set!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And I ordered the Salisbury steak set!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, settle down. Nobody's going to take your food.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What she said. Now, bon appetit.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Let's e...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Is it just me or is this rice omelet bigger than usual?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: My Salisbury steak's also like twice as big as usual!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I only ordered the Napolitan pasta, but it came with a helping of spaghetti carbonara.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I also received some sides that I didn't order.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
While making everything, I kept thinking about the me from that other SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I got so caught up remembering how happy I was to see her enjoying my food that I accidentally made way too much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I imagine it's hard not to feel proud as a cook after seeing someone devour your food the way she did.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: On the other hand, they'll need to hold an eating contest to get through all these plates.
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's getting late. I may've spent a bit too much time watching that little eating contest.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's see... Theater me should be...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mhm... Dive into... Sea of watermelons...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: A sea of watermelons? What kind of dream is she having?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see she's letting Luka use her lap as a pillow again.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh no... I'm going to crash into the seeds... Someone, give me some salt...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Seriously, what is this dream about?
I'm so curious now that I can't focus on the script for the show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, stop. Don't try to swim on my lap. Look, your blanket is falling off too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I wonder if she pampers Luka like this every time she lets her nap on her lap.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Normally, she causes the KAITO from this SEKAI a lot of trouble, but she's also someone who can look after others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She has that in common with cafemaster me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No matter how different their personalities are, they're both “me”. No wonder they're similar in some ways.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yawn...
Now I'm starting to get sleepy too...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Would I get to meet Luka in that dream if I fell asleep right now...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I can also swim...in the sea of watermelons...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She fell asleep...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I shouldn't disturb her, so I think I'll excuse myself here...
Hey, MEIKO, Luka! Where are you?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That voice...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: MEIKO! Luka!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We're going to start rehearsal soon!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you two like to join us?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They're looking for those two...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Everyone, they're over here!
These two are taking a nap right now!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, they can't hear me...
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone, MEIKO's over here on this bench!
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, there she is. There's no mistaking the back of her head.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ph-Phew... For a second there, I thought that we made eye contact.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But this...
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, MEIKO. We've been looking for... Ah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's fast asleep. And Luka's with her, I see.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She may've fallen asleep after letting Luka use her lap as a pillow.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I didn't know seeds floated in water... This means I can swim across the sea of watermelons...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Honestly, why a sea of watermelons...?
I'd rather eat it instead of swimming across it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Eat the sea?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wonder what kind of dream they're having!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No idea. But we can be sure that it's a fun one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we shouldn't wake them from their fun adventure. Why don't the four of us practice without them?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
Have fun in that dream, Luka, MEIKO!
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, I should also let them sleep.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sweet dreams, “me”.
